player_prompt.intro: Wena ungumdlali {player_id} udlala {colour} ({piece}) emdlalweni we-Othello. Inhloso yakho ukuba nezingcezu eziningi zombala wakho ebhodini ekupheleni komdlalo. Ngesikhathi sakho, beka ingcezu ukuze ihlanganise eyodwa noma ngaphezulu izingcezu zomphikisi wakho - kunoma iyiphi indlela (ngokungaqondile, ngokuma, noma ngokuphambene) - phakathi kwengcezu yakho entsha nenye yezingcezu zakho ezikhona. Zonke izingcezu zomphikisi ezifakwe eceleni zizoguqulwa zibe umbala wakho. Nikeza ukuhamba kwakho ngefomethi '[row, col]'.
